correctness.rationale: Independently reduced the upper flight using w=x-Hy+4μHz, which obeys w'=-2μw, and z''-2μz'+(1+μ²)z=1. The crossing conditions give the displayed x0,y0 and H=(ρ+E)/(1+Eρ), ρ=y0/x0 and E=e^(-2μt). For u=t-π, X=(1+k)/(k(1+μ²)), ρ=k(1-2μu)+O(u²) and E=k²(1-2μu)+O(u²), giving δ=cu+O(u²), A=cX and T=2t. For the return derivative, dt/dy=e^(μt)sin(t)/x0, and the derivative of the planar terminal y is -ρ/E by the planar flux/Jacobian identity. The involution then gives determinant ρ and trace H(ρ/E+E)+2μE(x0-Hy0)dt/dy. Expansion gives the stated trace coefficient and the simple eigenvalue derivative -2μ(1+k+k²)/D; squaring for the full return and changing parameter gives K. Rescaling the affine variation-of-constants expression in normalized time gives C¹ convergence separately on each flight; its explicit homogeneous form stays in the appropriate half-space and matches SP at π. These are fixed-μ statements, not uniform in μ or a claim about the original affine boundary orbit. Replay: RESULT.md lines 69–123 and Ferreira v1 Theorem 1 and Proposition 7.
